facts.fact: PPCC Executive Director Bodger Scott Johnson says Liberia's Electronic Government Procurement (e-GP) system, developed with European Dynamics, is in use, with 50 more ministries, agencies and commissions being trained for onboarding.
The PPCC head says with e-GP every stage of procurement, from planning to contract award, is tracked digitally.
The PPCC head says more than US$28 million in contracts have been awarded to Liberian-owned businesses through e-GP.
